verdict.rationale: Manufact documents its own observability feature: a Gateway Requests tab that shows every request flowing through the gateway, with optional full payload capture. A community member also praised the analytics shown in the demo. However, the docs only describe event-level request logs, not aggregated analytics, and one user reported no visibility into pay-as-you-go cost. Missing for 10: documented aggregate call-volume metrics, per-user breakdowns, error-rate analytics, cost/usage reporting (only a spend limit is documented, and a user reports no cost visibility), per-tool analytics, and org-level rollups across consumed/published servers.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see usage analytics for the servers and tools my org consumes or publishes — call volumes, users, errors, and cost

citations.quote: the Gateway Requests tab shows individual events: every request flowing through the gateway, refreshed every few seconds.
Toggle Capture payloads to also store full request and response bodies for each event
Impressed with the demo video, particularly the analytics, logs, and test suite features
